title: XBP Europe Is Now One of the Seven Approved Suppliers on GCA RM 6346 Framework
summary: XBP Europe secures supplier status approval for GCA RM6346 Framework. Read the full article to find out what it means for the public sector.
body_markdown:
> XBP Europe has been officially approved as a supplier under the prestigious Government Commercial Agency (GCA) RM 6346 framework and is now one of seven service providers.
>
>
> ## What It Means to Be an Approved Supplier on the GCA RM 6346 Framework
>
>
> The GCA RM6346 framework (officially titled Records Information Management, Digital Solutions and Associated Services 2) is a closed, UK-wide public sector procurement agreement managed by the Government Commercial Agency (GCA). The GCA RM 6346 framework is designed to streamline government access to essential services. Being an approved supplier on this framework means that a **company has successfully passed the stringent examination processes, demonstrating the exceptional standards in quality, data security, and operational reliability required to fulfill complex government contracts.**
>
>
> ## What This Implies for XBP Europe
>
>
> For XBP Europe, this milestone translates to a significant endorsement of its industry-leading capabilities. It opens the floodgates to expansion opportunities within the public sector by allowing XBP Europe to deliver transformative solutions to government agencies. In the long run, this appointment accelerates XBP Europe’s strategic growth while enhancing the end-user experience with secure, innovative, and efficient technology solutions.
>
>
> ## Why XBP Europe
>
>
> In the past, XBP Europe has digitised and processed around 280 million historical records dating back to 1837 for the UK’s HM Passport Office. This new appointment ensures seamless continuity of service for our existing public sector clients transitioning from the legacy RM6175 framework, while opening doors for new partnerships.
>
>
> “Our appointment to Lot 2 of the GCA’s RM6346 framework means more public bodies can now access our experience and digitisation solutions through a compliant, ready-made route. Our focus is simple: securely and accurately move paper-based processes into digital workflows, so services run faster and cost less to deliver.” – Daren Williams, Director of Business Development, XBP Europe
>
>
> ## How to Work With XBP Europe Through RM6346
>
>
> Public sector buyers can engage XBP Europe through direct award or further competition under RM6346.[Contact us](https://xbpglobal.com/contact/) to learn more.
